sloka: मृगीवोत्फुल्लनयना मृदुशीला तपस्विनी ।अपकारम् कमिह ते करोति जनकात्मजा ॥२-३८-९॥
transliteration: mṛgīvotphullanayanā mṛduśīlā tapasvinī ।apakāram kamiha te karoti janakātmajā ॥2-38-9॥

translations.english: What wrong has the daughter of Janaka largeeyed like a doe, so gentle and worthy of compassion done to you?
